scope: Reassess original 853 entries before sourcing additions; count each physical session identity once in every explicitly supported level.

admissions.name: Freestanding Handstand Push-Ups
admissions.trainingConditions: Practice the exact demonstrated movement and support, with shorter clean repetitions/holds and resets inside the 45-second opportunity where needed. Meet the physical prerequisites; no added assistance, apparatus, closed eyes or harder variant is inferred. Training is specific to this pattern.
admissions.observedAction: A real athlete performs unassisted freestanding handstand push-ups through visible elbow flexion and extension. Both palms and the head contact the floor; the full body remains framed. Direct shoulder and elbow-extensor work, demanding loading, and no wall assistance.

admissions.observedAction: A real athlete shifts support between palms and taps the opposite shoulder while maintaining a freestanding handstand. The natural alternating pair is intact. Direct supporting shoulder/elbow-extensor loading; hands require traction and concentrated-load compatibility.
